currentParagraphText: “So I die... with honor,” the Chieftain smiled as his eyes closed for a moment. He seemed to gather his last strength as he yelled loudly.

finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Retreat, my brethren! Return to the clan, and tell the Warlord I’ve joined the Ancestors!”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “You did your best, and that’s all anyone can ever ask for,” Jake simply responded, not willing to lie but also respecting his opponent enough to give him this last moment of dignity.
